title: B1 Core checkpoint
subtitle: Read a selected New Testament paragraph independently with a lexicon.
overview: At B1 Core, you can make a defensible first reading of a selected New Testament paragraph: map its grammar, identify its discourse movement, and use a lexicon without surrendering the text to a translation.
You are not yet expected to resolve every syntactic or theological question. The next stage will deepen non-finite constructions and discourse analysis.

sections.title: B1 Core outcomes
rows: Identify the main claim and its development.
Attach clauses, participles, infinitives, and phrases.
Distinguish literal draft from readable English.

items.grc: ὁ δὲ θεὸς πλούσιος ὢν ἐν ἐλέει διὰ τὴν πολλὴν ἀγάπην αὐτοῦ ἣν ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς.
items.en: But God, being rich in mercy, because of his great love with which he loved us.
By grace you have been saved.
